`final class StencilEmulation`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StencilEmulation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/StencilEmulation.java)

Stencil test and update done in the fragment shader, for a backend whose targets have no stencil buffer.

## Description

`StencilEmulation` turns the [`StencilState`](/reference/pipeline/stencilstate/) of the render state into what a shader translated with a stencil pass needs: whether to test, whether to write, and the values of its uniforms.
Draw the `WRITE` pass with the pipeline of [`PipelineKey.stencil`](/reference/pipeline/pipelinekey/#PipelineKey-factory-stencil) and the stencil fragment of the [`ShaderTranslation`](/reference/pipeline/shadertranslation/), then the draw itself.
No backend of JOID uses it: OpenGL and Vulkan have a stencil buffer on the window.

- [Stencil emulation](/build/shader-translation/#stencil-emulation)

## Creation details

<a id="StencilEmulation-factory-from"></a>

### from

`StencilEmulation from(RenderState state, boolean screen)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Reads the stencil of a render state.
Pass `screen` as `true` when the target is the window: off screen, nothing is tested nor written, as the core never uses a stencil in a framebuffer.

## Method details

<a id="StencilEmulation-method-write"></a>

### write

`void write(UniformBlock block)` 

Writes the stencil uniforms of [`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) (`STENCIL_TEST`, `STENCIL_FUNCTION`, `STENCIL_REFERENCE`, `STENCIL_MASK`, `STENCIL_FAIL` and `STENCIL_PASS`) into the block of the shader.
Call it before the block is sent for a draw; it throws `IllegalArgumentException` on a shader translated without stencil emulation.

<a id="StencilEmulation-method-isTest"></a>

### isTest

`boolean isTest()` 

If `true`, the draw tests the stencil: the target is the window and the stencil of the state is on.

<a id="StencilEmulation-method-isWrite"></a>

### isWrite

`boolean isWrite()` 

If `true`, the draw also changes the stencil, so it needs the `WRITE` pass first: the test is on and the fail or the pass operation is not `KEEP`.

<a id="StencilEmulation-method-getMask"></a>
